summary: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved.
